Colombia-South Korea Free Trade Agreement with investment chapter (in force 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Decree 830 of 2021 and Law 2370 of 2023 (Beneficiario Final definition and mandatory Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales maintained by DIAN); Circular Externa 100-000005 of 2020 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades (SAGRILAFT obligations); Decree 1674 of 2016 and UIAF Resolution 285 of 2023 (PEP classification)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague origin) plus official sworn Spanish translation in Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or companies authority of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization) plus official sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each UBO and legal representative
Certified bank reference letter evidencing legitimate source of funds for capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus official sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of criminal record for UBOs and proposed legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or judicial authority of origin country

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU Consolidated List, and Colombia's domestic PEP list under Decree 1674 of 2016 and UIAF Resolution 285 of 2023; SAGRILAFT requires identification of PEPs, their close associates and family members with enhanced due diligence, risk-based monitoring, quarterly re-screening at minimum, and immediate filing of a Reporte de Operación Sospechosa (ROS) with UIAF and suspension of the incorporation step upon any adverse hit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) operated by Confecámaras - www.rues.org.co, with back-office processing by the respective Cámara de Comercio
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish-compatible Latin script; accents and the letter ñ are permitted with Spanish collation rules; foreign-language tokens are allowed if not identical or confusingly similar to a registered name; the legal name must end with the mandatory type suffix 'S.A.S.'; names that include 'Colombia' or official-sounding designations require prior authorization by the competent authority.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection is a Cámara de Comercio administrative act; within 10 business days of notification, file a reconsideration request (recurso de reposición) before the same Chamber, and thereafter, where the rejection is maintained, file an appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 10 business days under Law 1437 of 2011 (CPACA); the reservation is not renewable but a new homonymy request may be submitted after making the name distinct; if the rejection is final, the incorporator may apply for a new name or seek judicial review before the Consejo de Estado.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with restrictions: a physical registered address (domicilio social) for service of process is mandatory under Article 21 of Law 1258 of 2008; virtual offices are accepted for low-risk e-commerce operators only where the provider guarantees receipt of judicial notices, DIAN correspondence and Chamber of Commerce citations; for bank and PayPal/Stripe onboarding, a verifiable physical operating or warehouse address is strongly recommended.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: low - estimated 5-10% annual probability of an unannounced DIAN profile inspection or Cámara de Comercio verification visit for a low-risk, license-free pet supplies e-commerce operator; probability rises to above 40% if inconsistent UBO data, high-value payment thresholds, or atypical transaction patterns are detected.

Drafting and execution of S.A.S. incorporation document (documento privado) and UBO register mapping details

RUT/NIT and preliminary DIAN tax pre-registration assistance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark (DIAN filing itself carries no direct fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of shareholder/UBO documents (average three documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark including third-party screening database license pass-through

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Código de Comercio arts. 373-432; Ley 222 de 1995; DIAN Resolución 000055 de 2023 (RUT)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social – Registro Único Empresarial (RUE), under supervision of Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento privado de constitución inscrito en el Registro Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for an S.A.S. Capital amount is freely fixed by the incorporator. Cash contributions must be deposited in a Colombian bank account in the company's name; no formal escrow account is mandated. Unpaid subscriptions may be paid within two years from registration, with later capital increases filed as amendments.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Resolution No. 1 of the Incorporator/Shareholder of [COMPANY] S.A.S.: The sole incorporator hereby resolves as follows: (1) ratify and confirm the subscription of share capital in accordance with the bylaws, each share having been subscribed and paid in conformity with the statutory payment schedule; (2) adopt and establish as the statutory registered office the address stated in the certificate of incorporation, where governmental notices will be received; and (3) appoint the undersigned legal representative and the common substitute representative listed in the bylaws, granting them all powers expressly authorized under Ley 1258 of 2008 and the articles of incorporation. Approved unanimously and executed by signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the VUE platform and perform an electronic name search (homologación) for the proposed S.A.S. corporate name. Submit the name reservation request and pay the corresponding tariff. The system issues a reservation certificate valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney if using an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as similar or prohibited, submit up to three alternative names immediately. If the platform fails, attend the Cámara de Comercio physical service window with the same dossiers to obtain a manual reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of notarized private incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (notary public) and Cámara de Comercio – Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the estatutos (bylaws) of the S.A.S. in Spanish, including corporate purpose, capital subscription, term, share classes, management structure, and dispute resolution. The document must be signed by all shareholders and acknowledged before a notary, or authenticated as private instrument. Submit for notarialization and obtain the corresponding first copy.
required_dossiers: Proof of shareholder authorized signature or certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises defects, amend the instrument by written addition and resubmit for notarization. If constitutional provisions fail legal review, revise the statutes to comply with Ley 1258 and related corporate law, then execute a corrective private document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized incorporation document through the RUE online platform or in person. Complete the registr mercantil pre-forms, declare the registered office, and pay registration fees and stamp tax. Upon registration, the Cámara de Comercio issues the certificate of existence and legal representation (certificado de existencia y representación legal).
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fees
Completed RUT pre-registration data if available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries any provision, cure by filing written affidavits or amendments within 10 business days. If registration is wrongly denied, appeal to the avocat of the Cámara de Comercio and, if necessary, to the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Registro Único Tributario (RUT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After commercial registration, access the DIAN Muisca taxation portal and obtain the company's NIT assignment. Complete the RUT with the legal representative's data, corporate activities under CIIU/ISIC 4791, principal tax responsibilities (income tax, VAT, withholding), and show the registered address. Request or renew the electronic signature certificate for future fiscal filings.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Legal representative's national ID or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is blocked or the NIT is not generated, correct the submitted data at the nearest DIAN customer service point and revalidate. If the legal representative lacks biometric validation, schedule an in-person appointment; the effective incorporation is not suspended during this cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account and electronic payment gateway setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank supervised by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; payment processors Stripe/PayPal (as internationally available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account in the company's name by submitting the registered documents and a board resolution authorizing the legal representative. Once the bank account is active, register the company's payment gateway accounts (Stripe, PayPal) with the legal entity details, NIT, and bank settlement instructions for the e-commerce pet-supply business.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Board resolution authorizing account opening and payment gateway setting
Certificate of UBO (beneficial owner) for AML due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide certified UBO declarations and institutional ownership documentation within 15 business days. For payment processors, resubmit rejected verification documents and confirm that the corporate legal name and address match the Cámara de Comercio registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for electronic retailing of pet supplies; no industrial or manufacturing authority is implicated. If a physical warehouse is later used, the local municipal planning and commerce authority may require use-of-land verification.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for pure e-commerce activity under ISIC 4791; no industrial or manufacturing operating permit applies. A municipal merchant registration may be required by local decree if the company maintains a commercial establishment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) – not triggered
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no environmental impact assessment is required for non-manufacturing electronic retail of pet supplies and pet care devices
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOCs, or combustion emissions are generated. Any domestic sanitary wastewater must meet the municipal sewer standards under Resolution 0631 de 2015. Solid waste handling, including packaging and returned goods, must comply with Decreto 1076 de 2018 on integrated solid-waste management.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification is not required for a virtual retail operation. If a physical warehouse is operated, obtain an inspection certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos for basic fire prevention. No structural load inspection is needed for business use of existing commercial premises. For any employees, register with an Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) and adopt the occupational health and safety program required by Resolución 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); transactional portal: MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co); institutional site: www.dian.gov.co; trade/customs processing through VUCE/SICEX (www.vuce.gov.co). Fiscal HQ: Cra. 8 N. 6C-38, Bogotá D.C.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1: Incorporate the S.A.S. by private document with a Colombian legal representative (representante legal) and register the deed with the Cámara de Comercio of the registered office; obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (chamber certificate). STEP 2: Foreign shareholders' signatures/powers-of-attorney must be apostilled (Hague Convention) and translated by a certified Colombian translator. STEP 3: Apply online for RUT (Registro Único Tributario) through MUISCA using the chamber certificate, tax domicile in Colombia, and legal representative's ID; the application creates the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) as the single statutory tax ID. STEP 4: Obtain a DIAN-issued digital certificate and electronic signature (firma electrónica) for authorized e-invoicing and e-filing. STEP 5: If trading, register pro forma in the SICEX/VUCE platform as an exporter and with the Banco de la República authorized FX intermediaries (if applicable). Timelines: RUT/NIT issuance typically 1–5 business days; no minimum capital requirement exists for S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The Colombian S.A.S. is a tax-resident juridical person (domiciled by incorporation or place of effective management, E.T. Art. 12-1) subject to corporate income tax at 35% (Ley 2277/2022). No pass-through eligibility for domestic or foreign shareholders; profits distributed to non-resident shareholders attract withholding tax (10% standard, 20% for privileged jurisdictions) on dividend remittances; branch profits and other Colombian-source income are similarly taxed at entity level. Territorial scope applies only to non-resident recipients; the S.A.S. is on worldwide-income taxation for Colombian-source and foreign-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Colombian law; entity classification follows corporate form. Available mechanisms: (1) Optional Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) combining VAT and income tax for small taxpayers with gross ordinary revenue below 100,000 UVT (≈ COP 4,762,000,000 for 2025) — election made in RUT; (2) mandatory transparency rules disregard foreign transparent entities/partnerships for income attribution to Colombian residents; (3) CFC rules (Ley 1819/2016 and subsequent amendments) attribute passive income of controlled foreign entities; (4) Hybrid mismatch rules introduced by Ley 2277/2022 (deduction-without-inclusion, double-deduction, and imported-mismatch anti-abuse provisions aligned with BEPS Action 2); (5) optional accelerated VAT refund filing for exporters representing >30% export revenue; (6) transfer pricing contemporaneous documentation elections under E.T. Arts. 260-1 et seq.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax), governed by E.T. Title V, Decree 1625/2016, DIAN resolutions on electronic invoicing
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis monetary threshold for goods retailers: any habitual sale of taxable goods situated in Colombia, delivery to Colombian consumers, or importation triggers mandatory IVA registration and NIT issuance (E.T. Art. 437). Occasional/non-habitual sellers of exempt goods only may be outside the obligation. For reference, the optional SIMPLE consolidated regime is capped at gross revenue of 100,000 UVT (COP 4,762,000,000 for 2025); e-commerce operators clearly exceed the 3,500 UVT small-provider exemption and must register regardless of volume.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV) for all IVA-responsible taxpayers since 2021. FEVs must be generated through DIAN-authorized technology providers (Proveedores Tecnológicos) or DIAN's free tool, transmitted as XML over web services to DIAN's VALIDATION service, which performs real-time schema/legal validation and returns a CUS E (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) for each invoice before it may be legally issued. Each invoice embeds a QR code with verification URL, the issuer's NIT, and the CUS E. Offline contingency is limited to 48 hours for systems failures. Additionally, the e-commerce platform must issue the 'documento soporte en adquisiciones' for purchases and comply with the periodic transmission of operative information (exógena) and the 'Radicación de facturas' portal obligations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: physical export is permanently excluded (0% IVA) under E.T. Art. 481(1), provided the seller is the exporter, goods exit Colombian customs territory within the statutory shipment window, and a validated DEX (Declaración de Exportación) is filed. Services: zero-rating requires the 'exported services' test under Decree 1625/2016 Art. 1.6.1.13.20 – recipient is a non-resident without Colombian domicile, the service is used exclusively abroad (including offshore e-retailing support, marketplace, SaaS, and logistics services rendered to foreign merchants), the remuneration is paid from abroad in foreign currency, and the service does not generate Colombian-source income to the recipient. E-commerce sale of pet supplies to foreign end-consumers qualifies as goods export when title/risk passes abroad and goods leave Colombia; purely digital services to foreign consumers qualify under the service-export rule. Refund mechanism: exporters recover input VAT through monthly or bimonthly 'saldo a favor' refund procedures, requiring DIAN-sealed export documentation and a clean audit file; export revenue share above 30% allows accelerated monthly filing.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) endorsed with Autorización de Embarque through DIAN's SICEX/VUCE computerized customs system
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill showing exit from Colombian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Canalización de Divisas) issued by the local authorized FX intermediary
Foreign Exchange Declaration (Declaración de Cambio – Form 7 for goods / Form 8 for services) filed with Banco de la República via the intermediary
Commercial invoice (Spanish/English) with HS 3924-3926/3407 or applicable pet-supply classification and incoterm

Service-export substantiation when relevant: contract, proof of non-resident recipient and exclusive foreign use, and audited export-of-services certificate (certificación expedida por contador público or revisor fiscal)
Packing list and cargo manifest consistent with the DEX values and weights
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN has a 5-year assessment window and may reclassify any zero-rated operation if the export record is incomplete, the goods did not effectively leave the country, or proceeds were not repatriated within 180 days. Clawback consequences: (1) reversal of the 0% treatment with assessment of 19% IVA on the transaction value, (2) moratory default interest on the retroactive deficiency, (3) inaccuracy penalty (sanción por inexactitud) up to 200% of the omitted VAT under E.T. Art. 647, and (4) rejection of VAT refunds with equivalent penalties plus restitution of refunded amounts. False or simulated export documents trigger criminal liability: 'defraudación fiscal' carries 36–108 months imprisonment plus fines of 150% of the evaded tax (Ley 2277/2022); aggravated forms using fictitious operations or false invoices attract higher imprisonment; customs smuggling offenses under Ley 1762/2015 apply to merchandise leaving undeclared or with falsified export declarations; FX non-repatriation violations separately expose the exporter to foreign-exchange fines up to 200% of the operation value and mandatory reintegration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) is the sole FX-regime authority, governing the 'Régimen de Cambios Internacionales' under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Decree 2555 of 2010 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervising Authorized Intermediaries (IMCs) and DIAN enforcing customs and anti-money-laundering rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a free-floating COP with broad current-account convertibility for cross-border e-commerce trade. The capital account is liberalized but administratively monitored: every resident cross-border FX transaction must be channelled through an Authorized Intermediary (IMC) of the Mercado Cambiario, and the IMC must file an electronic Declaración de Cambio with Banco de la República. Profit and dividend remittances require no ex-ante central-bank authorization; the paying S.A.S. must evidence distributable profits under local GAAP, compliance with non-resident dividend withholding and income-tax rules, and the corresponding exchange declaration. The practical remittance hurdles are therefore documentary and tax-completeness-based rather than exchange-approval-based.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, export proceeds must be collected and 'canalizado' through an IMC within six (6) months from the date of export, with a one-time extension of up to six (6) additional months available upon justified request accepted by Banco de la República. The mandatory conversion ratio is 0%: there is no statutory surrender of export receipts into pesos. Nevertheless, the full export value must be channelled through the Mercado Cambiario via an IMC or into a Banco de la República-authorized compensation account abroad, unless a de-minimis exemption applies to small-value retail e-commerce export receipts (threshold around the USD 10,000 equivalent per operation, subject to IMC confirmation). Proceeds collected through Stripe/PayPal may be parked in the authorized compensation account with quarterly balance reporting, or credited directly to an IMC foreign-currency account, and each collection event is disclosed in the applicable foreign-exchange declaration filed by the IMC.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (COP) + Registered Compensation Account (USD) + FX Line
Operational Current Account (COP) + Capital Subscription / Escrow Collection Account + FX Line
Operational Current Account (COP) + Foreign-Currency Deposit Account (USD)
Operational Current Account (COP) + Derivatives and Forward Account Line

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Viability rating: MEDIUM as a front-end collection gateway, LOW as an end-destination treasury account. Foreign EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, dLocal) are not Colombian IMCs and cannot perform the channeling and exchange-declaration duties imposed by DCIN-83. The compliant architecture is to allow Stripe and PayPal to collect card payments abroad and settle in USD into the S.A.S.'s Banco de la República-authorized compensation account or directly into an IMC account; funds are then declared and, if conversion is required, converted onshore at the free-market rate. Holding end-destination USD balances at a non-IMC EMI, without a compensation-account authorization, is a prima facie breach of the channeling regime and creates substantial KYC/AML adverse findings at Colombian banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian SFC due-diligence rules (Circular 029/2014 and SAGRILAFT) require complete identification of the S.A.S., its legal representatives, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners, but do not impose a statutory requirement that each director physically appear in Colombia. In practice, the registered legal representative (Representante Legal), who may be non-resident and act through a power of attorney, must undergo an in-person or notarized/video biometric compliance interview with the bank. Fully remote account opening is reserved for low-risk domestic entities; for the subject S.A.S., with non-resident owners and cross-border PSP rails, the bank will impose enhanced due diligence and at least one virtual or physical interview of a signatory, supported by notarized and apostilled corporate documents and a recent Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal obtained from the Cámara de Comercio.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Entity has 100% non-resident shareholding, no physical office in Colombia and an opaque UBO structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cámara de Comercio Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued within 30 days; notarized and apostilled certified copies of the S.A.S. by-laws, share register and capital-subscription minutes; the SFC-compliant Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) filing; passport/ID copies of all shareholders and legal representatives; a corporate-structure chart from the ultimate individual owners down to the S.A.S.; and a business-plan letter explaining the Colombia nexus, logistics and operating footprint of the e-commerce activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: USD receipts flowing from third-party payment service providers (Stripe and PayPal) without a visible invoice or contractual trail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed PSP merchant service agreements and platform terms; monthly payout reconciliation statements; order-level invoices matching the platform sales ledger; DIAN export declarations or customs registers (SIISEX/Siglo XXI); logistics contracts and shipping manifests proving physical dispatch of pet products; a documented refund and chargeback policy; and a treasury policy committing to channeling all collections through the IMC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder capital injection sourced from a jurisdiction inconsistent with the shareholder's stated residence or from an offshore hub, raising money-laundering suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 credit advice from the sending bank explicitly naming the shareholder; a bank reference letter from the remitting institution; the Declaración de Cambio filed by the receiving IMC under the direct-investment concept-code family; the notarized capital-subscription resolution; an accountant's certificate evidencing capital suscrito y pagado; and a documented source-of-funds statement for the subscribed capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Material time gap between export shipment and PSP settlement, creating reintegro-timing and trade-based money-laundering suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Marketplace settlement schedules and payout terms; a shipment-to-payment reconciliation schedule mapping each DIAN export declaration to its PSP payout and onward IMC channeling date; evidence of bank collection within the six-month legal term; carrier and customs departure records; and an attestation from the company's accountant on the closing FX position.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring chargeback and refund pattern implying non-delivery of goods or misuse of e-commerce rails.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Order fulfillment records including tracking numbers, customs export data and transporter delivery notifications; detailed customer service and dispute-resolution policies aligned with card-brand operating rules; PCI-DSS compliance attestation for the Stripe/PayPal integration; and chargeback-ratio reports demonstrating that dispute volumes remain within card-scheme thresholds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders inject capital via SWIFT MT103 from the remitting bank to the S.A.S.'s account at a Colombian IMC. The receiving IMC classifies the inflow under the Banco de la República concept code for direct capital investment in Colombia (code family 2101, inward FDI), files the applicable Declaración de Cambio, and credits funds to a COP or USD account after OFAC, UN-sanctions and UBO screening. If the investor seeks formal legal recognition of the investment for future dividend and capital repatriation, the IMC records it in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales of Banco de la República. No prior central-bank authorization is required; same-day settlement is available at the free-market COP/USD rate if conversion is elected, with the IMC charging standard transaction and exchange-declaration fees.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments for imports of pet products are cleared through the IMC's corporate digital channel via SWIFT MT103 for open-account trade, or via irrevocable documentary Letter of Credit under UCP 600 for large or strategically critical replenishment orders. Every outward remittance triggers an exchange declaration under the import-of-goods concept code supported by the import invoice, purchase order, transport document and the DIAN import declaration (processed through SIISEX/Siglo XXI). Payments for services or royalties to non-residents require withholding taxes to be applied and filed, together with transfer-pricing documentation where related parties are involved. Onshore COP disbursements for logistics, customs duties and domestic suppliers settle through the CUD clearing system, with the GMF (0.4%) financial-movements tax applicable unless an exemption is available.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable FX forwards (contratos a término) entered into with an authorized IMC solely to hedge the commercial export/import exposure.
COP/USD non-deliverable cash-settled forwards executed onshore through an IMC, with cash settlement in COP, permissible for hedging the e-commerce revenue cycle.
FX swaps and spot/forward combinations with authorized counterparties in the interbank Mercado Cambiario.
Purchased plain-vanilla COP/USD OTC options through an IMC, hedging only, with no short option positions permitted for non-financial corporates.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP) supporting long-term financing or investment, subject to IMC intermediation, Banco de la República reporting and evidence of an underlying commercial, trade or financing exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal (Renovación del Registro Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio via RUES (Chamber of Commerce / Unified Business Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers incremental surcharges on the renewal tariff, default interest, and administrative strike-off risks; failure to renew for two consecutive years may lead to cancellation of the commercial registration and loss of formal status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approved annual financial statements and shareholder meeting minutes filed with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (annual filings by Colombian legal entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than April 30 following the fiscal year-end; shareholder annual meeting must be held by March 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit financial statements and meeting minutes may result in monetary fines by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and adverse registry status; the company may be barred from certain legal transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in September, on the date determined by DIAN based on the last digit of the corporate taxpayer identification number (NIT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty equal to 5% of tax assessed or COP 1,000,000 (approx USD 250) where no tax is due; default interest accrues; persistent non-compliance may trigger asset embargoes and tax collection proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner disclosure (Reporte de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the month of March, in accordance with the assigned filing day based on the entity’s NIT; any subsequent transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership must be reported within one month thereof
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or submitting inaccurate UBO information carries fines of up to 20,000 UVT (approx USD 6,000) and may be doubled for repeated omissions, without prejudice to updated reporting requirements after share transfers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual exogenous tax information declaration (Información Exógena)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in August or September, depending on the last digit of the NIT; exact dates are published by DIAN in the preceding resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or inaccuracy triggers fines per falsified information format; fines range and are proportional to data involving third-party tax effects; habitual non-compliance can block tax clearance certificates and increase audit scrutiny.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) when total gross assets or gross income at the prior year-end exceed 5,000 UVT (approximately COP 235 million / USD 58,000) or when the company has 50 or more employees; mandatory also for entities carrying on regulated financial, insurance, or public-interest activities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: COLGAAP (Decreto 2420 de 2015): Full IFRS for Group 1, IFRS for SMEs under Grupo 2 for most medium-sized companies, and a simplified micro-entity framework for Grupo 3 micro-enterprises; the entity must apply the framework defined at its legal inception.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must file its current beneficial owner(s) with DIAN once every calendar year during the March filing window keyed to its NIT. If any share transfer or corporate control change alters the beneficial ownership, the company must update the UBO report within one month of the transaction. The annual confirmation requires a complete identification of natural persons with direct or indirect ownership, control, or profits exceeding 5% of the company.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Share Transfer and Pledge Registration Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 180–400 per year for a registered agent and office address service in Colombia
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200–3,500 per year for a certified external audit or Revisor Fiscal engagement in a small to mid-size S.A.S.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 30% for tax year 2025 and thereafter (35% for tax years 2023-2024) pursuant to Ley 2277 de 2022, applicable to Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas (S.A.S.) taxed at entity level.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific income tax holiday for ISIC 4791 e-commerce; applicable incentives include: (i) deduction of 100% of qualifying investments in science, technology and innovation (STI) capped at 20% of net taxable income; (ii) 50% additional deduction on salaries of new employees under 28 years of age; (iii) exclusion of dividends received from other Colombian resident companies if those profits were already taxed; (iv) no wealth tax (impuesto al patrimonio) for corporate taxpayers.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (no statutory expiry); annual offset of tax losses limited to 50% of net liquid ordinary income before the loss offset under Art. 147 Estatuto Tributario.
